scope: Concrete finite entry in a NEW CPU process, calling original analysis_h._pair_context with fresh parallel original source verification inside each original ledger. No actual admission launched by reviewer.

findings.title: Pinned acceptance report is not used to enforce its accepted canonical proof hashes
findings.impact: The entry hard-pins the all-three acceptance report, but never reads its current_canonical_proof_sha256 map. It takes fresh current hashes of gate/ledger/seal paths instead. A live proof file can therefore differ from the accepted snapshot yet be admitted into the before/after pin set; an unselected backbone gate is not later checked by the selected backbone original pair-context path. This is a canonical global evidence-admission gap, not a bypass of the selected backbone original full verifier or PNG/RGB checks.
findings.fix: Read the mandatory expected proof map from the pinned acceptance report and require every accepted path/hash before scientific imports. Seed pins from accepted expectations, validate their canonical path/shape/inventory as appropriate, and reject rather than overwrite any accepted value when adding current dependencies. Add regression tests with a live value differing from an unchanged accepted map and with an expected accepted-map entry missing.

verified_strengths: Default main is inert. CLI bounds backbone and seed; existing output is preserved; the real path requires empty CUDA visibility and exactly two OMP/MKL/OpenBLAS threads before scientific imports.

The exact qualified 20-source manifest, reviewed helper/adapter digests and final registry are checked. Actual source/input hashes are checked before the original science import and around every adapted ledger and final context.

The entry rejects preimported reliability_v2 modules, checks canonical paths for directly used scientific modules, derives the exact selected effective ten runs, and injects the ORIGINAL worker_h.verify_run_completion into the reviewed restored adapter.

Original analysis_h._pair_context calls original cache_h.verify_cache for two histories times seven roles. Its original _validate_live/_context/_target_authorization calls the temporarily adapted queue audit; _read_manifest still calls full _validate_inputs byte and decoded RGB checks; original cache chunk/head/provenance checks remain in place. No override to those functions exists.
A success requires fourteen adapted ledgers, fourteen cache completion markers and ten fresh source completions per ledger. Publication uses the accepted atomic no-overwrite publisher.
test_coverage_boundary: The five new entry tests exercise inert default, no-I/O inert path, existing output, CPU/thread rejection and invalid CLI values. They do not exercise successful input-pins construction against the accepted proof map, missing/mismatching accepted pins, foreign module paths or late entry failures. The independent in-memory probe covered the reported accepted-map mismatch without altering any file or importing science.
